prompt: Why doesn't chlorobenzene undergo SNAr with NaOMe under mild conditions, while 2,4-dinitrochlorobenzene does?

options.label: The nitro groups stabilize the Meisenheimer (negative) intermediate via resonance.

explanation: SNAr requires stabilization of the negative Meisenheimer intermediate. Nitro groups ortho/para to the leaving group accept the charge via resonance; chlorobenzene has no such stabilization.
